text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTO-PAGE fired for inference-gateway (prod-usw2) — symptom: sustained 5xx error-rate spike (>120 r/min). Pager: @oncall-jordan

oncall-jordan: acked. looking now. any recent deploys? :eyes:

alex: I see a canary deploy to auth-proxy ~3m ago. spike lines up. 90% of 5xx are 502 from auth-introspect service.

oncall-jordan: nice catch. rolling the canary back now. command: `deploy rollback auth-proxy/canary`

incident-bot: deploy rollback auth-proxy/canary started by oncall-jordan at 1777771290

lee: rolling back. also scaling ingress pool +2 to absorb retries while we confirm. `kubectl scale deployment/ingress -n inference --replicas=6`

tara: copying relevant logs — short tail:
```
2026-03-17T02:07:12Z auth-introspect WARN upstream read timeout
2026-03-17T02:07:13Z gateway ERROR 502 POST /v1/generate client=app-123
2026-03-17T02:07:14Z auth-introspect ERROR connection reset by peer
```
Most 502s are 1) auth upstream failing, 2) increased client retry rate.

cs-maya: any customer-facing impact yet? do we need to open an incident page for customers?

oncall-jordan: initial telemetry: ~3% of requests hit 5xx in the last 10m, primarily non-critical smaller orgs on default routing. No active P1 customer reports in Zendesk. tagging CS to monitor.

incident-bot: rollback completed at 1777771385 — canary removed, traffic routed to stable.

alex: after rollback and scaling, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in metrics (see grafana link: https://grafana/reports/ingress-5xx?from=now-30m). still watching.

lee: I also applied short-lived retry-suppression rule on the edge for 60s to avoid thundering herd while auth recovers: `route-config:set suppress-retries=true ttl=60s`

tara: confirming logs now show no new auth-introspect errors in the last 2m.

oncall-jordan: good. i'll keep monitoring for 15m then start a handoff. summary for next oncall: cause likely bad canary in auth-proxy -> provoked upstream failures; mitigation: rollback canary, scale ingress, apply retry suppression. no customer P1s. follow-ups: run canary job with warmup auth checks before redeploy, add rate-limiter on client retries.

alex: noted. i'll take next shift at 1777771500 and keep this open until end of watch window. tagging @cs-maya for postmortem/status page if needed.

cs-maya: will draft a short customer FYI if anything changes. thanks team :thumbsup:
